name: optcatalog_spawn_runtime_instance_at
description: OptCatalog::SpawnRuntimeInstanceAt allocates runtime projectile storage, links it into the entry active list, initializes owner/position/scale state, and attaches the projectile to the runtime world.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog runtime-instance source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x4aeaa0 validates allocation through AllocOrReuseAttachNodeClone, pushing the runtime onto entry->activeRuntimeListHead, copying spawn position, clearing lifetime, storing ownerNode, consuming g_OptCatalogNextSpawnScale and resetting it to 1.0, setting projectile raycastable/damage handler/callbackContext, storing projectileScale from entry->flyoutHealth, setting projectile world position, and AddChild(g_OptCatalogRuntimeWorld, projectileNode).

The native OptCatalog runtime free-list smoke verifies active-list insertion, runtime owner/position/spawn-scale/projectile-scale fields, next-spawn-scale reset, projectile node flags, damage handler, callback context, object position, and runtime-world attachment.
